fm.title: Wireless hdl
fm.description: HDL-optimized wireless communication building blocks for FPGA (3 blocks)

rows.intent: HDL-optimized blocks for forward error correction — use for implementing channel coding in FPGA-based wireless receivers
HDL-optimized modulation and demodulation blocks — use for implementing digital modulation schemes in FPGA-based wireless transceivers
HDL-optimized utility blocks for wireless designs — use for signal conditioning, buffering, or format conversion in FPGA wireless implementations
